## Workload

Lena Fischer completed 675 reads during the review period, recording 324 hours of work. This represents 2.1 reads per hour. The workload was reviewed in relation to the recorded hours and the overall number of reads completed. The figures provide a clear summary of activity for the period and support consideration of the current working arrangements.

## Quality

A sample of 62 reads was checked as part of the quality review. The agreement result was 61.3 per cent. This outcome was considered alongside the workload information and the checks completed during the review. Lena Fischer and Priya Anand agreed to retain the current session pattern. The review was completed by Priya Anand.
